title_en: Our school’s official website is live
summary_uz: Endi maktab yangiliklari, natijalari va suratlarini bir joyda — oʻzbek va ingliz tillarida kuzatib borishingiz mumkin.
summary_en: School news, results and photos are now in one place — in Uzbek and English.
body_uz:
Alisher Navoiy nomidagi IDUMning rasmiy veb-sayti ishga tushirildi. Sayt oʻquvchilar, ota-onalar va maktabimizga qiziqqan barcha uchun ochiq.

Bu yerda maktab tarixi va taʼlim modeli, soʻnggi yangiliklar va eʼlonlar, shuningdek, maktab hayotidan suratlar jamlangan. Sayt oʻzbek va ingliz tillarida ishlaydi.

Biz bilan bogʻlanish uchun sahifa pastidagi telefon raqami va Facebook sahifamizdan foydalanishingiz mumkin.
body_en:
The official website of Alisher Navoiy IDUM is now live. It is open to students, parents and everyone interested in our school.

Here you will find the school’s history and education model, the latest news and announcements, and photos from school life. The site is available in Uzbek and English.

To get in touch, use the phone number and Facebook page at the bottom of every page.

title_en: A reading hour in the school library
summary_uz: Oʻquvchilar ustozlari bilan kutubxonada jamlanib, badiiy asarlarni birgalikda mutolaa qilishdi.
summary_en: Students gathered in the library with their teacher to read literature together.
body_uz:
Maktab kutubxonasi — oʻzbek tili va adabiyotiga ixtisoslashgan maktabimizning yuragi. Navbatdagi kitobxonlik soatida oʻquvchilar ustozlari bilan birga badiiy asardan parchalarni tingladilar va fikr almashdilar.

Kutubxona devorlarida Abdulla Qodiriy, Zahiriddin Muhammad Bobur va Alisher Navoiy portretlari oʻquvchilarni soʻz sanʼatining buyuk anʼanalariga daxldorlikka undab turadi.

Maktabimiz shiori ham shuni eslatadi: qancha koʻp bilsang, shuncha koʻp bilmasligingni tushunasan. Kitob esa bu yoʻldagi eng yaqin hamroh.
body_en:
The school library is the heart of a school specializing in Uzbek language and literature. At a recent reading hour, students listened to passages from a literary work with their teacher and shared their thoughts.

Portraits of Abdulla Qodiriy, Zahiriddin Muhammad Bobur and Alisher Navoiy on the library walls remind students that they are heirs to a great literary tradition.

Our motto says it well: the more you know, the more you realize how much you don’t know. A good book is the best companion on that journey.

title_en: A literary evening in honour of the written word
summary_uz: Milliy liboslardagi oʻquvchilar sahnada sheʼr va adabiy kompozitsiyalar bilan chiqish qildi.
summary_en: Students in national dress performed poetry and literary compositions on stage.
body_uz:
Maktabimizda adabiy kechalar anʼanaga aylangan. Navbatdagi tadbirda oʻquvchilar milliy liboslarda sahnaga chiqib, sheʼrlar va adabiy kompozitsiyalarni ijro etdilar.

Sahna bezagi — kitoblar va portret bilan bezatilgan stol — kechaning ruhini yanada boyitdi. Bunday tadbirlar oʻquvchilarda nutq madaniyati, sahna madaniyati va adabiyotga mehrni tarbiyalaydi.

Adabiy kechalar ixtisoslashgan maktabimizning oʻzbek tili va adabiyotiga boʻlgan eʼtiborini yaqqol aks ettiradi.
body_en:
Literary evenings have become a tradition at our school. At the latest one, students in national dress took to the stage to recite poetry and perform literary compositions.

The stage setting — a table decorated with books and a portrait — added to the atmosphere of the evening. Events like these build confident speaking, stage presence and a lasting love of literature.

Literary evenings reflect our school’s specialization in the Uzbek language and its literature.

title_uz: Bitiruvchilarimizning 70 foizdan ortigʻi B2 va C1 sertifikatlariga ega
title_en: More than 70% of our graduates hold B2 and C1 certificates
summary_uz: 10–11-sinf bitiruvchilarining 70 foizdan ortigʻi ingliz va rus tillaridan B2 va C1 darajadagi sertifikatlarga ega.
summary_en: More than 70% of grade 10–11 graduates hold B2 and C1 level certificates in English and Russian.
body_uz:
Xorijiy tillarni puxta egallash — maktabimizning oʻziga xos ustunligi. 10–11-sinf bitiruvchilarimizning 70 foizdan ortigʻi ingliz va rus tillaridan B2 va C1 darajadagi sertifikatlarga ega.

Bu natija oʻquvchilarning tizimli mehnati va ustozlarning fidoyiligi samarasidir. Til sertifikatlari bitiruvchilarimizga oliy taʼlim va kelajak rejalarida keng imkoniyatlar ochadi.

Ona tili va adabiyotiga chuqur mehr bilan birga xorijiy tillarni oʻrganish — bizning taʼlim modelimiz asosidir.
body_en:
Mastering foreign languages is one of our school’s defining strengths. More than 70% of our grade 10–11 graduates hold B2 and C1 level certificates in English and Russian.

This result reflects the steady work of our students and the dedication of their teachers. Language certificates open wide opportunities for our graduates in higher education and beyond.

A deep love of the native language and its literature, combined with strong foreign languages, is at the core of our education model.

title_uz: SAT natijalari: 58 nafar oʻquvchi yuqori ball, 17 nafari 1500+
title_en: SAT results: 58 students with high scores, 17 above 1500
summary_uz: Soʻnggi bir yilda 58 nafar oʻquvchimiz SAT imtihonida yuqori natija qayd etdi, ulardan 17 nafari 1500 va undan yuqori ball toʻpladi.
summary_en: In the past year, 58 of our students achieved high SAT scores, and 17 of them scored 1500 or higher.
body_uz:
Soʻnggi bir yilda maktabimizning 58 nafar oʻquvchisi SAT imtihonida yuqori natija qayd etdi. Ulardan 17 nafari 1500 va undan yuqori ball toʻpladi.

SAT xalqaro miqyosda tan olingan imtihon boʻlib, unda yuqori natija ingliz tilini chuqur bilish, mantiqiy fikrlash va tizimli tayyorgarlikni talab qiladi.

Natijalarga erishgan barcha oʻquvchilarimizni va ularni tayyorlagan ustozlarni chin dildan tabriklaymiz!
body_en:
In the past year, 58 students from our school achieved high SAT scores, and 17 of them scored 1500 or higher.

The SAT is an internationally recognized exam, and a strong result requires excellent English, clear reasoning and consistent preparation.

Warm congratulations to every one of these students and to the teachers who prepared them!

title_uz: 2025–2026 oʻquv yili: 291 bitiruvchidan 203 nafari oliy taʼlimda
title_en: 2025–2026: 203 of our 291 graduates admitted to higher education
summary_uz: 2025–2026 oʻquv yilida maktabimizni 291 nafar oʻquvchi tamomladi, ulardan 203 nafari oliy taʼlim muassasalariga qabul qilindi.
summary_en: In the 2025–2026 academic year, 291 students graduated from our school, and 203 of them were admitted to higher education institutions.
body_uz:
2025–2026 oʻquv yilida maktabimizni 291 nafar oʻquvchi tamomladi. Ulardan 203 nafari oliy taʼlim muassasalariga qabul qilindi.

Har bir natija ortida oʻquvchining yillar davomidagi mehnati, ustozlarning sabr-toqati va ota-onalarning qoʻllab-quvvatlashi turibdi.

Barcha bitiruvchilarimizni tabriklaymiz va ularga yangi bosqichda ham bilimga chanqoqlik va kamtarlik hamroh boʻlishini tilaymiz.
body_en:
In the 2025–2026 academic year, 291 students graduated from our school, and 203 of them were admitted to higher education institutions.

Behind every result are years of effort by students, the patience of their teachers and the support of their families.

We congratulate all our graduates and wish them curiosity and humility in learning at every new stage of their lives.
